1.w: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

2.w: “Until when will you speak these [things], and the words of your mouth [be] a mighty wind?

3.w: Does God pervert judgment? Or [does] Shaddai pervert justice?

4.w: If your sons have sinned against Him, then He has sent them into the hand of their transgression.

5.w: If you seek diligently for God, and ask Shaddai for favor,

6.w: if you [are] pure and upright, surely now He will rouse Himself over you and restore the abode of your righteousness.

7.w: And your beginning was small, and your end will greatly increase.

8.w: For inquire, please, of the former generation, and consider the finding of their fathers.

9.w: For we [are] of yesterday, and we do not know; indeed, our days [are] a shadow upon the earth.

10.w: Will they not instruct you and speak to you, and from their heart bring forth words?

11.w: Can the papyrus rise up without a marsh? Can the reed grow without waters?

12.w: It is still in its greenness—it is not cut down, and before all grass, it withers.

13.w: So [are] the paths of all those forgetting God; and the hope of the godless will perish,

14.w: for whom his confidence shall be cut off, and his trust the house of a spider.

15.w: He leans upon his house, and it does not stand; he takes firm hold on it, and it does not arise.

16.w: He [is] lush before the face of the sun, and over his garden, his shoot goes forth;

17.w: over a rock-pile his roots are wrapped, he looks for a house of stones.

18.w: If one destroys him from his place, then it will disown him: ‘I have not seen you.’

19.w: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and from the dust another sprouts up.

20.w: Behold, God will not reject the blameless, and He will not strengthen the hand of those doing evil.

21.w: Yet He will fill your mouth [with] laughter, and your lips with a shout of joy.

22.w: Those hating you will be clothed [with] shame, and the tent of the wicked [will be] no more.”
